value.rationale: All-parameter integral homotopy classification of a natural family of nonuniform height-two trees, with a sharp mixed-dimension transition and explicit low-degree symmetry that qualitative vertex-decomposability cannot recover. Both binomial factors have intrinsic structural meaning: independent star-join contributions and the root-link contribution; this is not a routine single-width extrapolation.
